changeSet.sql: CREATE OR ALTER FUNCTION graph.GetForwardLineage ( @currentHop int, @endHop int, @assetIds dbo.Ids readonly, @intersectIds dbo.Ids readonly ) RETURNS TABLE AS RETURN ( with f as ( select I.IntersectID, I.PredicateID, I.PredicateUid, I.PredicateName, I.PredicateType, @currentHop as SubjectHop, H.ID as SubjectID, @currentHop+1 as ObjectHop, O.ID as ObjectID from @assetIds H inner join Asset S on S.ID = H.Id inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.Subject = S.Object and I.SubjectID = S.ObjectID and I.PredicateType in (1, 12, 13) inner join Asset O on O.Object = I.Object and O.ObjectID = I.ObjectID union all select I.IntersectID, I.PredicateID, I.PredicateUid, I.PredicateName, I.PredicateType, f.ObjectHop as SubjectHop, f.ObjectID as SubjectID, f.ObjectHop+1 as ObjectHop, O.ID as ObjectID from f inner join Asset S on S.ID = f.ObjectID and f.ObjectHop <= @endHop inner join PredicateIntersect I on I.Subject = S.Object and I.SubjectID = S.ObjectID and I.PredicateType in (1, 12, 13) and I.IntersectID <> f.IntersectID and I.IntersectID not in (select Id from @intersectIds) inner join Asset O on O.Object = I.Object and O.ObjectID = I.ObjectID ) select * from f )
